description: Address code review issues: canvas overlay overflow, SW/manifest paths, UserComment EXIF encoding, canvas rendering duplication, localStorage logo quota risk, QRIS tag 54 insertion fix, and manifest start_url.
steps: Fix canvas overlay height to be calculated from actual content size (fontSize * lineHeight * lines + padding)
Extract overlay rendering into shared function used by both renderPreview() and doDownload()
Fix service worker registration path to use ?page=sw and manifest href to use ?page=manifest
Remove manual ASCII charset prefix from UserComment EXIF field
Add try/catch and size check around localStorage.setItem for logo
Fix QRIS tag 54 insertion to use hard-coded position before tag 55 or 58
Add comment acknowledging client-side payment design decision
acceptance_criteria: Overlay height dynamically calculated from content, not from image height
Single renderOverlay function called by both renderPreview and doDownload
UserComment passes raw JSON string without manual charset prefix
Logo upload rejects files over 500KB and wraps setItem in try/catch
Tag 54 inserted using hard-coded position before tag 55 or 58
manifest.json start_url is ./ with deployment note
verification: Run: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const html=fs.readFileSync('/projects/sandbox/timestamp/index.html','utf8'); const checks=['?page=manifest','?page=sw','renderOverlay','500 * 1024']; const missing=checks.filter(c=>!html.includes(c)); if(missing.length){console.error('Missing:',missing);process.exit(1)} console.log('All review fixes present')"
